Ovaj vignette je podsjetnik za novi EODHD sloj u `findata`. Cilj je od raw
EODHD fundamentals JSON fileova i daily adjusted price podataka dobiti lokalne
panel tablice, fundamentalne indikatore i long-short faktor prinose bez
look-ahead biasa.

## Input folderi

Pipeline ocekuje:

- `fundamentals_dir`: folder s raw EODHD JSON fileovima, po mogucnosti jedan
  file po simbolu, npr. `AAPL.US.json`
- `prices_dir`: folder s daily price CSV/parquet fileovima
- `output_dir`: lokalni folder u koji se pisu finalne parquet tablice

Daily price fileovi trebaju imati barem:

- `date`
- adjusted close kolonu, npr. `adjusted_close`, `adj_close`, `adjClose` ili
  slicno

## Kreiranje pipeline objekta

`EodhdFundamentals` je samo koordinator. On ne sadrzi svu logiku, nego poziva
testabilne funkcije iz paketa i zapisuje output tablice.

```{r}
library(findata)

eod <- EodhdFundamentals$new(
  fundamentals_dir = "F:/fundamentals/fundamentals",
  prices_dir = "F:/eodhd-prices",
  output_dir = "data/eodhd"
)
```

## Build all

Najkraci nacin:

```{r}
eod$build_all(filter_common_us = TRUE)
```

Ovo izgradi i zapise:

```text
security_master.parquet
quarterly_fundamentals.parquet
daily_market_cap.parquet
monthly_returns.parquet
monthly_characteristics.parquet
market_cap_outliers.csv
```

`market_cap_outliers.csv` je audit tablica. Outlieri se ne brisu automatski osim
ako eksplicitno trazis cleaning.

```{r}
eod$build_all(
  filter_common_us = TRUE,
  clean_market_cap_outliers = FALSE
)
```

## Korak po korak

Ako zelis pregledati intermedijarne tablice:

```{r}
sm <- eod$build_security_master(filter_common_us = TRUE)
qf <- eod$build_quarterly_fundamentals(security_master = sm)

dmc <- eod$build_daily_market_cap(
  quarterly_fundamentals = qf,
  security_master = sm
)

mr <- eod$build_monthly_returns()

chars <- eod$build_monthly_characteristics(
  quarterly_fundamentals = qf,
  daily_market_cap = dmc,
  monthly_returns = mr,
  security_master = sm
)
```

## Finalne tablice

Kasnije ih mozes ucitati bez ponovnog buildanja:

```{r}
sm <- read_security_master("data/eodhd")
qf <- read_quarterly_fundamentals("data/eodhd")
dmc <- read_daily_market_cap("data/eodhd")
mr <- read_monthly_returns("data/eodhd")
chars <- read_monthly_characteristics("data/eodhd")
```

`chars` je glavna tablica za factor engine. Ima jedan red po `symbol x month`,
plus:

- `ret`
- `signal_date`
- `fund_available_date`
- `fiscal_date_ending`
- `market_cap`
- `sector`
- `industry`
- fundamentalne indikatore kao `book_to_market`, `gross_profitability`,
  `roa`, `fcf_yield`, `accruals`, `asset_growth`, `piotroski_f_score`,
  `qmj_score`, `cash_generation_score`

## Look-ahead pravilo

Za mjesecni return u mjesecu `t`, fundamentals podaci smiju biti dostupni samo
do kraja mjeseca `t - 1`.

Validacija:

```{r}
validate_no_lookahead(chars)
```

Pipeline staje ako postoji red gdje je:

```r
fund_available_date > signal_date
```

## Market cap

Daily market cap se racuna kao:

```r
market_cap = adjusted_close * shares_outstanding
```

Broj dionica se rolla samo iz zadnjeg poznatog fundamentals zapisa na ili prije
datuma cijene. Ako je source date u buducnosti, validacija mora pasti.

```{r}
validate_market_cap_coverage(dmc)
```

Outliere mozes auditirati:

```{r}
outliers <- flag_market_cap_outliers(dmc)
outliers[market_cap_outlier == TRUE]
```

I tek onda eksplicitno ocistiti:

```{r}
dmc_clean <- clean_market_cap_outliers(dmc, outliers = outliers)
```

## Faktor prinosi

Factor specs su tablica, ne hardkodirana logika:

```{r}
specs <- factor_zoo_specs()
specs
```

Izracun cijelog factor zoo-a:

```{r}
factors <- build_factor_zoo(
  characteristics = chars,
  specs = specs,
  start_date = "2006-01-01",
  weighting = "value",
  min_stocks_side = 10
)

validate_factor_returns(factors)
```

Sa summaryjem:

```{r}
summarize_factor_returns(factors)
factor_correlation_matrix(factors, start_date = "2006-01-01")
```

## Jedan long-short faktor

```{r}
gross_profitability <- build_long_short_factor(
  characteristics = chars,
  characteristic = "gross_profitability",
  direction = "high_minus_low",
  breakpoint_universe = "NYSE",
  breakpoints = c(0.3, 0.7),
  weighting = "value",
  min_stocks_side = 10,
  start_date = "2006-01-01"
)
```

## Sector-neutral faktor

Pravilo za sector-neutral faktore:

- rank se radi unutar `month x sector`
- top 30 posto minus bottom 30 posto
- value-weighted unutar sektora
- equal-weight prosjek sektora

```{r}
cash_generation <- build_sector_neutral_factor(
  characteristics = chars,
  characteristic = "cash_generation_score",
  direction = "high_minus_low",
  weighting = "value",
  min_stocks_side = 10,
  start_date = "2006-01-01"
)
```

## Tipican research flow

Research skripte bi trebale samo citati output iz `findata` i raditi analizu.
Primjer:

```{r}
chars <- read_monthly_characteristics("data/eodhd")

factors <- build_factor_zoo(
  characteristics = chars,
  specs = factor_zoo_specs(),
  start_date = "2006-01-01"
)

summary <- summarize_factor_returns(factors)
cors <- factor_correlation_matrix(factors, start_date = "2006-01-01")
```
